title: Prime Number Theorem
subtitle: Number Theory · Distribution of primes
summary: The count of primes up to x grows asymptotically as x/ln x.
detail:
\[ \pi(x) \sim \frac{x}{\ln x} \]

Proved independently by Hadamard and de la Vallée-Poussin (1896) using properties of the Riemann zeta function. A sharper form is \(\pi(x)\sim\operatorname{Li}(x)=\int_2^x dt/\ln t\). The Riemann Hypothesis would give the best possible error bound.
